current.name: Git commits signed by a hardware-bound SSH key
current.summary: Sign git commits with a non-exportable P-256 key in the TPM or Secure Enclave, through git's SSH signing, so that a signature proves the commit came from this machine.
current.reason: machine-signing 0.1.0 implements this design: TPM and Secure Enclave keys with opt-in Touch ID, SSH signing, the preferred agent key, and init with GitHub registration. CI and a real Mac verified it.
